value.value:
usage: pdf COMMAND ...
  text FILE [--page N]                  the text, pages split by form feeds
  grep [--case] [--json] [--first] PATTERN FILE...  FILE:PAGE: line, for each line with a hit
  json FILE [--page N]                  the page model: lines, boxes, links, outline
  info FILE                             pages, metadata, and what could not be read
  outline FILE                          the bookmarks, with their pages
  bench FILE                            the time each stage of reading takes
  images FILE [--page N] [--out F.pgm]  the page's images, decoded; --out saves the largest
  view FILE [--page N] [--find TEXT] [--print] [--cols N]
                                        the text layer in a window; --print shows it here
